title: Correct maximal-order final evidence gates
objective: Make the maximal-order final-evidence harness enforce the audited coverage, timing, overlap, OM, cold-boundary, oracle, source-currentness, and sampling semantics

handoff.summary: The final-evidence evaluator now requires complete direct-reference, algorithm-overlap, oracle, and cold-boundary matrices; explicit OM suppressed-control evidence; current committed source/native identities; and internally consistent three-sample performance rows. Primary evidence defaults to three retained samples, while randomized and cold exactness retain their deliberate one-sample contracts.
risks: The final real evidence collection must now include explicit unavailable/unsupported rows for every optional reference boundary instead of omitting tools or cases.
Heavy baselib/native suites were deliberately not run because this source-only lane was instructed not to compete with the active proof benchmark.
next_steps: After integration and when the host is free, run pnpm test:baselib:strict and pnpm test:native from the final source identity.
Collect final primary, cold, oracle, overlap, and platform evidence under the strengthened terminal matrices.
